Memory, logging and context parameters

Source: R/ast.R
z3_memory_usage.Rd

z3_memory_usage() estimates the memory, in bytes, that Z3 has allocated in this R process. z3_log_append() writes a comment into the API log opened with z3_log_open(). z3_update_param() changes a configuration parameter of an existing context.

Usage

z3_memory_usage()

z3_log_append(text)

z3_update_param(ctx, name, value)

Arguments

text

Text for the log.

ctx

A z3_context().

name, value

Parameter name and value.

Value

A number, or the input invisibly.

Examples

z3_memory_usage()
#> [1] 18291752
ctx <- z3_context()
z3_update_param(ctx, "timeout", 5000)
